verdict.rationale: Rootly documents alerts arriving from Datadog and Sentry, and an AWS connector that lets Rootly AI read CloudWatch metrics, so part of the named stack has first-party support. Grafana and Prometheus are never mentioned, and no step-by-step setup guides appear for any of these tools. missing for 10: Grafana integration, Prometheus integration, documented setup steps for Datadog/Sentry/CloudWatch, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, first-party integrations cover my observability stack — Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, Sentry — with documented setup

citations.quote: Alerts arrive programmatically from monitoring tools like Datadog, PagerDuty, or Sentry
Once connected, Rootly AI can look up CloudWatch metrics, EC2 instance state, RDS database status, SQS queue depth, and other AWS services during investigations
Connect observability, code, docs, and cloud tools so Rootly AI can investigate and use provider actions your provider permissions allow.
